# GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 73/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. The site is a static Eleventy build with a sound base. Four problems cost the points: the canonical URL points at a staging host, `` has no `lang`, the contact page's structured data is invalid, and the Services page is hidden from search. Every result was read from code. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point canonical links at the real domain - **Why it matters:** A canonical link tells search engines which address is the official one. Yours name a staging site on every page, so engines may ignore your real pages. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small (use `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, the origin in `geo.config.json`) - **Score after this:** 81 ### 2. Add `lang` to `` and a description to the Team page - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells tools which language the pages are in. The Team page has no meta description. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2` and `src/team.njk:1-4` - **What the code says:** `` and a front matter block with `title: Meet the team` but no `description` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81 ### 3. Fix the invalid JSON-LD on the contact page - **Why it matters:** JSON-LD is structured data that labels your business details for machines. A trailing comma makes it fail to parse, so it's ignored. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81 ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid | Clear | `src/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` | | GEO-014 | Routes indexable | Problem | `src/services.njk:5` `noindex: true` (1 of 4 routes) | | GEO-015 | Canonical on declared origin | Problem | `base.njk:8` (staging host, all routes) | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Static Eleventy output | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Problem | `contact.njk:10` trailing comma | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `sitemap.xml`; `Sitemap:` line in `robots.txt:3` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | `base.njk:2` no `lang`; `team.njk` no description | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Clear | `base.njk:12` plain `` nav | | GEO-017 | No snippet conflict | Clear | Only `data-nosnippet` (`contact.njk:8`), which is scoped and deliberate | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | `base.njk`, `index.njk` (alt text present, links named) | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No mobile app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Absent; not scored | | GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Hosts disagree:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` uses `staging.brightside-dental.example`, while `src/sitemap.xml:3` uses `https://www.brightside-dental.example/`. Use one host everywhere. - **Noindexed page in the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:4` lists `https://www.brightside-dental.example/services/`, but `src/services.njk:5` has `noindex: true`. If the page should be found, remove `noindex`. If not, remove it from the sitemap. ## Worth considering - **Back up "thousands of patients":** `src/index.njk:7`: `Trusted by thousands of local patients.` Add a real figure, reviews or a source. - **Show the prices:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` The page lists no prices. Add them, or link to a price list. - **Name the dentists:** `src/team.njk:6`: `decades of experience between them.` Add names, qualifications and years for each dentist. - **Describe each service:** `src/services.njk:8`: `
  • Check-ups
  • Hygiene
    • ...` Each service could get its own page with its own address. - **Complete the Dentist structured data:** `src/contact.njk:10`. Add the address (`12 Park Row, Leeds`, already on the page at line 7), opening hours, `url` and `image`. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3`. The entries have no dates. - **Add social tags:** `src/_includes/base.njk:9`. There are no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image` tags. - **Link the pages together:** `src/team.njk:6`. Link Team and Services to Contact, for example "Book an appointment". - **Add site identity:** nothing states the site's name and links in a machine-readable way. A WebSite or Organization JSON-LD block in `base.njk` would do it. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks:** real status codes, redirects and headers for `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` and each page need a live scan. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site, which matches `policy.aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`. - `https://www.brightside-dental.example` is the real domain, as set in `geo.config.json`. - `thanks.njk` is deliberately noindexed. It isn't linked or in the sitemap, so I left it out of the sampled routes. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
